objective: Frozen computation: every patch of the weave without holes up to eleven knots, random patches, parallelograms, rings of patches.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 4 of 6 predictions held, P1 and P3 failed narrowly): on 22,143 weave patches without holes every unbonded pair (12,318) is two lone distinctions of opposite classes facing each other, and a patch is a true distance exactly when it has none; every parallelogram to 16 distinctions has exactly one unbonded pair; the criterion and identity hold; b = steps + 1 on all but 64 bonded pairs (steps + 2); 7 of 502 facing pairs inside their parallelogram are bonded.
title: Census of weave patches
